listing.aiSummary: Provides optimal fleet fitting and optimization based on combat stats and AI behavior.

description:
Auto Outfitting
"Optimal" autofit for Starsector 0.98a+0.98.5a.

Source code
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional and adds a settings menu (F3).
Updating: Delete the old folder in mods/ and extract the new one, or use TriOS.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove mid-game

No required mods

Disclaimer
It's built on the numbers for every weapon, hull and ship I could find, from vanilla and my installed mods. It won't always beat a fit you build by hand. It's "optimal" because it balances your whole fleet in one go with almost no effort from you. It sure ain't perfect, lmao, but enjoy.

Buttons
Optimal (refit screen, Autofit list): Fits the selected ship with what it has access to. A hand-built fit can still be better.
Optimize fleet: Opens a settings panel first (storage, stored ships, shops, s-mods, officers, augments), and it remembers your picks per save. Plan fleet plans every combat ship from one shared stock, biggest first, and shows each change and its CR cost. Apply to all ships puts the fits on. Officers move to the ship they help most, and you and AI cores stay put.
Order fleet weapons: Lists the weapons and fighters the plan is missing, with prices. Queue all orders them through custom production (vanilla or AoTD). Running it again only orders what's still missing.
Fleet analysis: Shows your fleet's damage mix, fighter roles and weak spots. It doesn't change anything.
Lock this ship: Keeps a ship and its weapons out of Optimize fleet and Order fleet weapons.

How ships are fitted

Stock: Optimal uses what you tick in the Autofit panel. Optimize fleet uses what's on your ships, your cargo, the storage where you're docked, and the shops if you tick them. Order fleet weapons checks every storage, so it doesn't order what you already have.
Scoring: It scores weapons and hullmods on combat numbers and how the AI flies the ship, counting officer skills, d-mods and CR. It's an estimate, and no battles are simulated.
Roles: Each ship gets fitted for the job it's good at, going off its size, speed, ship system and type. Fast frigates grab points and hunt weak ships, slow tough ships like the Enforcer brawl, and support carriers (Heron, Condor, Astral) hang back with PD and missiles.
Flagship: The ship you fly gets an all-round fit with its own PD and both kinetic and armor-cracking damage, and it gets first pick of the weapons. You can turn that off with Balanced flagship.
Buying: Optimize fleet can buy weapons and LPCs at the market you're docked at (legal shops and black markets each have a tick). It pays normal prices, only spends up to your credit limit (25% by default), and bigger ships buy first.
Civilian ships: Freighters, tankers and salvagers get campaign hullmods and no weapons.
S-mods: They're only built in when you tick Build in s-mods, and it keeps at least 5 story points by default. Frigates get 1 s-mod at most and destroyers 2, since those points usually do more on capitals.
Changing s-mods: It can use the game's Change s-mods with credits at your own colony with heavy industry. That's expensive (75,000 to 250,000 credits per s-mod), so it's off by default and only used when a ship gets at least 10% stronger.

Getting started

Open the refit screen and pick a ship.
Press Autofit, then Optimal.
Press Confirm to keep it.

Screenshots
The refit screen buttons:

An Optimize fleet plan:

Order fleet weapons:

Compatibility

Modded ships: Anything from any mod is rated from its stats. Supported mods also get rules for their special effects.
Fleet Toolkit: It works as is. If its Autofit Menu is on, turn off "Replace Vanilla Button" so Autofit opens the game's menu with Optimal in it.
Ship Mastery System: Turn off its "S-mod autofit option" in LunaLib, or it replaces Optimal.
Bugs: Post here or open a GitHub issue with your starsector.log and modlist.

Supported mods
They're all optional, and each one turns on when its mod is enabled.
Large integrations
LunaLib It adds the settings menu (F3).
MagicLib Weapon interference penalties are counted.
Ashes of the Domain (Vaults of Knowledge) Orders can use AoTD production, and the Entropy Lance isn't fitted.
Random Assortment of Things Orders can go through a Frontiers settlement, alterations stay on, and its special effects count.
Emergent Threats (and IX Revival) AI Subsystem Integration is never built in, and its drones and special parts count.
United Aurora Federation Its Secondary Focus, hullmods and weapon effects count.
Seeker - Unidentified Contact Plague hulls only fly plague LPCs, and plague gear costs CR on other hulls.
Weapon effects
Tahlan Shipworks Its weapon effects and special hulls count, and the Manannan isn't fitted.
Diable Avionics Its weapon effects count, and built-in weapon selectors stay.
Knights of Ludd Its weapon effects, Lidar and Knight Refit count.
Amazigh's Ship Foundry, Valkyrian, Roider Union Their weapon effects and hulls count.
Interstellar Imperium, Stardust Ventures, Ship/Weapon Pack, Tri-Tac Expansion, Junk Yard Dogs, Hillock Prototype and Station Tech, Jackundor's Advanced Arms Their weapon effects count.
Secrets of the Frontier, THREAT TECH Their weapon effects count, and fragment weapons are scored by the ship's swarm.
Hullmods
Arma Armatura Hullmods that do nothing aren't used as filler.
Industrial.Evolution Its weapon effects and Forge World Experiment count.
Yunru's Arsenal, Yunru's Hullmods, YunruCore Install hullmods and Let's Bayblade! aren't added, and weapon effects count.
Ship Mastery System Its s-mod slots count. Turn off its S-mod autofit option in LunaLib.
AI Tweaks, Starship Legends Their hullmods stay, Starship Legends traits count, and Custom AI goes on cruisers and capitals.
Omega Core Everywhere, There Be Juggernaughts, What We Left Behind, Attuned Drive Field Their hullmods are handled.
Treasure Hunt Its package is valued on civilian ships.
Advanced Modifications Its effects count, and hullmods that use up cores only go on ships that already paid.
Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition Its hullmod stays, and augments go on the ship they help most (at a friendly market with a spaceport).
Other mods
Any other mod It's rated from its stats.

Ask here or on GitHub if you want support for another mod.

Permissions: It's free to use, change and reupload, in modpacks too. No credit needed, just don't sell it.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all code in this mod was created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: None.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Colonies | Auto-er Pilot | all my mods on GitHub
